name: Marvel Movies Quiz
description: How well do you know the Marvel Movie Universe?

questions.question: What is the real name of Iron Man?

answers.comment: Sorry, Bruce Banner is the real name of the Hulk.
Correct, Tony Stark is the billionaire genius who becomes Iron Man.
Bruce Wayne is the real name of Batman, a DC Comics character!
Incorrect, Steve Rogers is the real name of Captain America.

questions.question: Who directed the first 'Avengers' movie in 2012?

answers.comment: Sorry, not this time, Taika Waititi directed 'Thor: Ragnarok' and 'Thor: Love and Thunder'.
Not correct. James Gunn directed 'Guardians of the Galaxy' (2014) and 'Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2' (2017).
Incorrect, Jon Favreau directed 'Iron Man' (2008) and Iron Man 2 (2010).
Correct, Joss Whedon directed both 'The Avengers' (2012) and 'Avengers: Age of Ultron' (2015).

questions.question: Which Infinity Stone does Vision have embedded in his forehead?

answers.comment: Correct, Vision is powered by the Mind Stone, originally housed in Loki’s scepter.
Sorry, not the right stone! The Power Stone was housed in the Orb, and later kept on Xandar by the Nova Corps.
Not correct. The Time Stone was housed in the Eye of Agamotto, used by Doctor Strange to manipulate time.
Way off, this stone does not exist in the Marvel Cinematic Universe.

questions.question: What is the name of Thor's hammer?

answers.comment: Close, Stormbreaker was the name of Thor's Axe.
Sorry, Gungnir is the name of Odin's spear.
Sorry, wrong mythology. Hepheastus is the Greek god of blacksmiths and fire.
Correct, Mjolnir is Thor’s enchanted hammer.

questions.question: Which Marvel movie introduced Black Panther?

answers.comment: Incorrect, Vision and Pietro & Wanda Maximoff (Quicksilver and Scarlet Witch) were introduced in Avengers: Age of Ultron. Black Panther was not in this movie.
Correct, Black Panther first appeared in Captain America: Civil War (2016).
Incorrect, Black Panther does not appear in Iron Man 3.
Sorry, although this is Black Panther's first solo movie, he was introduced earlier in the MCU.

questions.question: What is Peter Quill's alter ego?

answers.comment: Correct, Peter Quill often refers to himself as 'Star-Lord'
Nope, Nova Prime is the leader of the Nova Corps, a intergalactic police force.
Incorrect, Rocket is the name of the genetically modified raccoon in Guardians of the Galaxy.
Sorry, this was David Bowie's alter ego, not Peter Quill's.

questions.question: What is the name of the AI that replaces J.A.R.V.I.S. in Tonty Stark's Iron Man suits?

answers.comment: F.R.I.D.A.Y. becomes Tony’s new AI assistant after J.A.R.V.I.S. evolves into Vision.
Close, Even Dead, I'm The Hero (E.D.I.T.H.) is an AI created by Tony Stark and bequeathed to Peter Parker.
Way off... R2D2 is a droid from the Star Wars universe.
Just - Nope.

questions.question: In Doctor Strange, what is the name of the ancient relic that controls time?

answers.comment: Close, but incorrect. The Book of Vishanti was an ancient book of knowledge referenced in Doctor Strange.
Sorry, this is the crown worn by the fire demon Surtur in Thor: Ragnarok.
Incorrect, the tesseract houses the Space Stone.
Correct, The Eye of Agamotto houses the Time Stone.

questions.question: Which actor made a surprise cameo as Loki in the Asgardian stage play in Thor: Ragnarok?

answers.comment: Correct, Matt Damon played the actor portraying Loki in the humorous stage play on Asgard.
Sorry, Kevin Bacon made a cameo appearance in The Guardians of the Galaxy Christmas Special.
Nope, however, Brad Pitt 'appeared' in Deadpool 2 as the actor portraying Vanisher.
Incorrect, Luke Hemsworth, brother of Chris, plays the Thor actor in the Asgardian stage play.

questions.question: What is the name of the intergalactic police force featured in Guardians of the Galaxy?

answers.comment: Incorrect, the Ravagers are a group of space pirates led by Yondu Udonta.
Correct, The Nova Corps are the peacekeeping force on Xandar.
Incorrect, the Sovereign are a genetically engineered race of beings led by Ayesha.
Incorrect, the Kree Guard are the elite soldiers of the Kree Empire.
